data.action: 并肩共读留三厘米距离，侧脸微近，余光偷看
data.camera: medium two-shot, window seat reading, dust motes, quiet intimacy
data.description: 【秀知院图书室·午后】辉夜与你并肩坐在靠窗的阅读位，两本书之间刻意留出三厘米的距离——这是她计算过的、既不会越界也不会疏远的安全值。翻页的间隙她的侧脸靠近了一点，红瞳的余光一直落在你的书页上。午后的光尘在两人之间浮游，谁都没有开口，谁都没有挪开。
data.lighting: 窗边洒落的明亮午后光与浮游光尘
data.location: 秀知院图书室靠窗阅读位
data.promptProse: Kaguya Shinomiya sits beside her companion at the library window, keeping a small measured gap between their open books while glancing toward his page. Her black school dress, white blouse and red hair ribbon stay neat as she leans slightly nearer. The medium two-shot includes the shared desk and shelves beyond. Afternoon window light reveals drifting dust and paper edges, while their elbows cast separate soft shadows that nearly meet across the tabletop.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 图书室的共读午后·「距离……刚好是三厘米」
